회사 소개
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Business Operations팀은 쿠팡이츠 머천트와의 계약을 최종 승인하고, 입점부터 거래 해지까지의 전체적인 흐름을 관리합니다.
쿠팡이츠 내 유관 팀과 긴밀하게 협력하여 위험 요소를 관리하고, 비즈니스 프로세스를 구축합니다. 다양한 프로젝트와 도전을 통해 개인의 역량을 키울 수 있는 기회를 제공하고 있습니다.
업무 내용
1. 내부 통제 및 운영 모니터링
팀 내 업무 및 프로세스가 사내 규정 및 정책에 따라 운영될 수 있도록 정기적인 점검 및 모니터링 수행
2. 감사 대응 및 컴플라이언스 지원
내·외부 Audit 및 컴플라이언스 관련 자료 준비 및 문의 대응 지원
유관 부서와 협업하여 필요한 정보를 정확하게 관리 및 전달
3. 증빙 서류 및 데이터 관리
운영 과정에서 발생하는 각종 증빙 서류 및 데이터를 체계적으로 취합·관리
컴플라이언스 리스크 예방을 위한 문서 관리 및 운영 지원
4. SOP 및 운영 프로세스 개선 지원
운영 과정에서 발생하는 이슈와 비효율 요소를 파악하고 개선 과제 발굴
SOP 및 운영 가이드라인의 업데이트와 개선 활동 지원

운영 과정에서 발생하는 문제를 꼼꼼하게 확인하고 원인을 분석하려는 문제 해결 역량을 갖추신 분

jobs.description: Senior Test & Evaluation Lab Tech (Metrology & Calibration) Company: The Boeing Company The Boeing Metrology and Test Equipment Services (MATES) organization is looking for an Senior Calibration Technician to join our Metrology team in Fort Greely, Alaska . This role will be responsible for using calibration standards to calibrate, adjust, certify, maintain, and repair Measurement Test & Equipment (MT&E)/process equipment using approved calibration procedures, process specifications, equipment drawings, and M&TE /process equipment manufacturer's performance specifications. In addition to Metrology responsibilities, this role may also involve activities including but not limited to: logistics associated with routing calibrated assets to remote Boeing labs and suppliers for calibration services (shippers, purchase contracts, follow-up and supplier backlog management). This position may also involve aspects of Test Asset Management and Property Management including asset tagging, redeployment, storage and surplus. Metrology And Test Equipment Services (MATES) provide a full spectrum of test asset and metrology services and support for internal customers and products through all phases of the product lifecycle. Services include calibration/certification for dimensional/optics, electrical/electronic and mechanical/physical measurement and test assets, sourcing management, measurement solutions, repair & maintenance, test asset selection and use, acquisition, allocation, resource and lifecycle management, and specialized test services. MATES is comprised of engineers, technicians and administrative personnel who support programs, sites, business units and external/government customers by providing best value test asset management and metrology services through all phases of the product lifecycle. What is metrology? Metrology is the science of measurement. MATES is responsible for establishing an unbroken chain of measurement traceability from the point of application to internationally recognized standards, quantities, values or reference materials. Applied metrology at Boeing ensures that measurement standards, materials or equipment used to apply or determine measurement quantities are defined, repeatable, reproducible and traceable. ロケットナウ（Rocket Now）について
ロケットナウは、送料とサービス料が無料のフードデリバリーサービスです。和食、洋食、ヘルシー志向の料理など多彩なジャンルの料理から、デザートやドリンクまで迅速かつお得にお楽しみいただけます。サービスは、北海道、東北（仙台）、関東（東京・神奈川・埼玉・千葉）、中部（愛知・静岡）、関西（大阪・京都・兵庫）、広島、九州（福岡）を中心に展開中です。 ロケットナウアプリは、グローバルマーケットインテリジェンス企業の「センサータワー（Sensor Tower）」が主催する「Sensor Tower APAC Awards 2025」にて、「2025年に世界でローンチされた飲食店注文・フードデリバリーアプリ部門」で「世界最多ダウンロード数を記録」したアプリに認定されました。また、『Best App Award 2025』において、カテゴリ別部門ショッピングカテゴリ優秀賞を受賞。iOS／Androidの両アプリストアのダウンロード数は、フードデリバリーアプリ部門9カ月連続1位を獲得しました*1。アプリはサービス開始*2から15カ月で500万ダウンロードを突破するなど成長を続けています。 ＊1 2025年7〜2026年3月 iOS、Android 統合ベース ＊2 2025年3月30日 サービスリリース時点 （出所：Global Market Intelligence: Sensor Tower）
CP One Japan
について
CP One Japan合同会社は、NYSE（ニューヨーク証券取引所）に上場しているFortune 150のテクノロジー企業Coupang, Inc.（NYSE: CPNG）の日本法人です。CP One Japanは、日本国内で「ロケットナウ（Rocket Now）」ブランドのフードデリバリーサービスを運営しており、Coupangの技術力と革新的な物流ソリューションを生かして、迅速で信頼性の高い顧客志向のフードデリバリーサービスを日本の消費者に提供することに尽力しています。
募集職種
シニアパフォーマンスマーケティングスペシャリストは、新規顧客獲得およびLTV最大化に向け、データドリブンなパフォーマンスマーケティング施策の企画・実行・分析・最適化をリードします。ウェブおよびアプリのUAチャネルをインハウスで運営し、効率的な予算配分とROIの最大化を通じて事業成長に貢献します。
主な業務内容
UAチャネルの直接運営および最適化:
外部代理店を介さず、検索広告、SNS広告、ディスプレイ広告、アフィリエイトなど主要なオンライン獲得チャネルのキャンペーンを直接設計、実行、管理し、日次ベースでの最適化を実施します。

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Safeguards Enforcement Lead on the User Well-Being team, you will be responsible for managing our child safety, mental health, abuse and exploitation, and age assurance enforcement workflows. This will include managing the team responsible for scaling, maintaining, and continuously improving the systems and processes we use to detect and respond to these harms.

This is a management role. You will serve as the central point of contact for those who conduct content review, managing day-to-day workflows, quality assurance, and escalation processes. You will also work closely with internal Engineering, Policy, and Legal teams to scale detection systems and close enforcement gaps as the threat landscape evolves.

Important context for this role: In this position you will regularly be exposed to and engage with explicit content of a sexual nature involving minors, as well as content that may be violent or psychologically disturbing. Anthropic takes the wellbeing of team members working in this area seriously and provides access to wellness resources and support. Candidates should carefully consider this aspect of the role before applying.

Key responsibilities

•

Manage a team of individual contributors across multiple policy areas under the User Well-Being banner

•

Serve as the primary point of contact for review partners conducting content review, including onboarding, training, quality assurance, and ongoing relationship management

•

Design and improve enforcement workflows to scale effectively as volume grows, while maintaining high accuracy and consistency across review decisions

•

Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams to optimize detection models and automated enforcement systems for User Well-Being policies

•

Develop and maintain internal documentation, decision trees, and review guidelines that enable accurate and consistent enforcement at scale

•

Keep up to date with emerging AI policy enforcement best practices, evolving legal frameworks, and developments in technology, and use these to inform our workflows

•

Identify and report trends in misuse patterns to internal stakeholders, including Policy, Legal, and Trust & Safety leadership

•

Coordinate reporting obligations to relevant external bodies (e.g., NCMEC) in accordance with applicable law and Anthropic policy

Minimum qualifications

•

Experience managing teams in the User Well-Being space

•

Experience in trust & safety, content moderation operations, or policy enforcement with direct exposure to child safety, mental health, abuse and exploitation, and age assurance harm areas

•

Experience managing or coordinating content review operations, including quality assurance and workflow management

•

Experience standing up and scaling policy enforcement or content review workflows

•

Proficiency in SQL and/or other data analysis tools to monitor workflow health, review queue metrics, and surface enforcement trends

•

Experience identifying emerging risks and communicating findings to cross-functional stakeholders, such as Product, Policy, Engineering, and Legal teams

•

Understanding of the challenges involved in implementing product policies at scale in the content moderation space

Preferred qualifications

•

Deep subject matter expertise in child safety, child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSEA), online child protection, mental wellness, and age assurance

•

Experience working with or reporting to NCMEC, IWF, or equivalent child safety reporting bodies

•

Familiarity with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks, including CSAM reporting obligations, KOSA, COPPA, or equivalent international frameworks

•

Experience working with generative AI products, including an understanding of how AI systems can be misused to generate or facilitate abusive content

•

Experience designing or evaluating trauma-informed support structures and wellness protocols for content reviewers working with harmful material

•

Proficiency in Python for workflow automation or data analysis

•

Experience working with hash-matching technologies (e.g., PhotoDNA, CSAI Match) or perceptual hashing tools used in CSAM detection

•

Familiarity with age assurance technologies and their role in child safety enforcement

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$330,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Position Overview:

The Principal Solution Architect, Data is responsible for defining, scaling, and governing enterprise-wide or business solution architecture across platforms, domains, and delivery teams. This role shapes how technology solutions are designed, integrated, secured, and operated consistently across the organization. While architecture is foundational, the Principal Solution Architect, Data will be responsible for designing solutions in close collaboration with the business and technology stakeholders. Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and align to business and technology requirements.

Operating at an enterprise or portfolio level, the Principal Solution Architect, Data focuses less on individual solution delivery and more on establishing architecture patterns, standards, guardrails, and building solutions that enable teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions at speed.

This role operates within a federated Enterprise Architecture (EA) model, partnering closely with business technology and platform teams to shape solutions in real time while improving accountability, speed, and delivery alignment. The architect remains connected to the central EA core through enterprise standards, governance, communities of practice, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure consistent, risk-aware technology decisions across domains.

This role partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align to business strategy, are resilient and compliant, and can scale across multiple use cases without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.

This Principal Solution Architect, Data role will have a strong focus on data solution architecture, modern data platforms, data products, and AI-enabled capabilities across the Insurance business.

The role bridges business, engineering, architecture, and data teams to rapidly design, build, and deploy scalable solutions that improve underwriting, enrollment, billing, claims, customer service, Producer, reporting, analytics, and digital experiences.

The architect will champion a data product mindset, treating data as a strategic enterprise asset with clear ownership, quality standards, reusable capabilities, governance, and measurable customer value.

• Own and shape enterprise or business solution architecture strategy, standards, and patterns across multiple platforms and domains.
• Define and maintain reference architectures and reusable design patterns (“golden paths”) for solution delivery.
• Establish architectural guardrails that enable scalable, secure, and consistent solution design across teams.

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

Tripledot Games was the very first studio ran by Tripledot Studios, and is a leading developer and publisher of casual and puzzle games, with a strong presence in London, Warsaw and Barcelona. We’re looking for a commercially minded, high-impact HR Business Partner to join Tripledot Games (TDG).

This is a key strategic hire working closely with the VP People to help shape, implement, and embed a high-performance culture across TDG. The role will partner directly with senior leaders across two critical areas of the business: Zephyr Mobile and the wider Engineering organisation across Tripledot Games.

You’ll operate as both a strategic partner and hands-on operator, helping leaders scale teams, raise performance standards, strengthen organisational capability, and navigate growth and change in a fast-paced global gaming environment.

The ideal candidate is commercially sharp, data-driven, highly collaborative, and comfortable balancing strategic thinking with practical execution. You’ll thrive in ambiguity, move quickly, and bring a modern, pragmatic approach to people partnership.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic People Partnership

• Partner with studio and functional leaders to shape people strategies that support business growth, performance, and organisational effectiveness.
• Work closely with the VP People to help embed and scale a high-performance culture across TDG.
• Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organisation design, leadership capability, workforce planning, engagement, and performance.
• Translate business priorities into practical, scalable people initiatives and actions.

Performance & Talent

• Drive high standards of performance management, accountability, and feedback across your areas.
• Support leaders in identifying, developing, and retaining top talent and critical capabilities.
• Facilitate talent reviews, succession planning, and development discussions.
• Coach managers on performance conversations, team effectiveness, and leadership impact.

Organisational Effectiveness & Change

• Partner with leaders through periods of growth, transformation, restructuring, and change.
• Support organisational design and scaling initiatives across engineering and studio teams.
• Use data and insight to identify people risks, trends, and opportunities, helping leaders make informed decisions.
• Collaborate with centres of expertise and wider People teams to deliver impactful solutions across learning, reward, engagement, and hiring.

Employee Experience & Culture

• Own and improve key people practices and employee lifecycle experiences within your business areas.
• Help create an inclusive, high-performing environment where people can do their best work.
• Champion initiatives that strengthen engagement, collaboration, communication, and leadership effectiveness.
• Support the evolution of modern people practices that are scalable, lightweight, and fit for a fast-moving gaming company.

Operational Excellence

• Balance strategic partnership with strong operational execution and follow-through.
• Build trusted relationships across globally distributed teams and studios.
• Partner effectively with Talent Acquisition/HR Ops/L&D and wider HR teams to support growth plans and hiring needs.

Requirements

• HRBP experience within a fast-paced, commercial, scaling business — ideally within gaming, tech, product, or digital environments.
• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to deeply understand business priorities and connect them to people strategy.
• Experience partnering with senior leaders in product, engineering, or technical organisations.
• Proven ability to influence, challenge, and coach leaders effectively.
• Experience operating in high-growth or rapidly changing environments.
• Strong understanding of performance management, talent development, organisational design, and employee engagement.
• Comfortable using data and insight to support decision-making and prioritisation.
• Pragmatic, low-ego, hands-on approach with strong execution capability.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across multiple cultures and geographies.
• Experience supporting globally distributed teams is highly desirable.
• Exposure to M&A integration, studio integration, or organisational transformation is a plus.
• Progressive, modern view of HR with a focus on simplicity, impact, and user experience.
• Comfortable travelling occasionally to support studios and leadership teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Strong, trusted partnerships with leaders across Zephyr Mobile and Engineering.
• Clear improvements in leadership capability, organisational effectiveness, and performance standards.
• Scalable people practices that support growth without unnecessary bureaucracy.
• Better visibility of talent, people risks, and capability gaps.
• A stronger culture of accountability, feedback, and high performance across the organisation.
